concepts.definition: practices that maintain cleanliness and reduce the spread of disease
the intake and use of food nutrients needed for growth, energy, and body maintenance
an illness caused by an infectious agent that can pass between hosts directly or indirectly
the administration of a vaccine to stimulate protective immune responses against a disease

a state of emotional, psychological, and social well-being that supports daily functioning
immediate basic assistance given to an injured or suddenly ill person before advanced care is available
physical, mental, and social well-being in matters relating to the reproductive system
harmful or inappropriate use of drugs or other substances that can damage health or functioning
organized efforts to protect and improve the health of populations and communities
